purpose: Design proposal for confirmation; illustrative content; not an app screenshot.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a finished high fidelity desktop application design proposal for Lune, a Chinese collaborative music listening app. Landscape 16:10, crisp legible Chinese typography, edge-to-edge actual app UI, no device or browser frame, no annotations. The attached existing app screenshot is a STYLE REFERENCE only: inherit its near-black surfaces, ivory Chinese sans serif text, fine separators, restrained lavender accents and uninterrupted bottom player. Replace its right narrow panel with a spacious unified full music workspace.

Screen: playlist search results, keyword 夜晚. A narrow left navigation rail shows Lune / 一起听, then 正在播放, 搜索音乐, 发现歌单 (selected), 共听热榜, 我的音乐; room group 播放队列 12 and 房间成员 3. Settings appears only at rail bottom, with understated room status 3 人在房间 and 邀请码 206418. Main content: heading 发现歌单 aligned with a single search field containing 夜晚 and trailing magnifying glass; one compact source selector 全部音源. Below, result line “夜晚” 的歌单 · 8 个结果. Generous but efficient grid of eight music playlists, four columns, two rows. Each card is an uncluttered square photographic music cover with slightly rounded corners, then a clearly separated two-line title block BELOW, then muted creator and track count. Titles: 夜色慢慢落下 / 把夜晚交给爵士 / 城市入梦以后 / 风吹过的房间 / 月光经过窗台 / 耳机里的远方 / 在凌晨醒着 / 慢一点，也没关系. Covers are refined photographic album art: coastal dusk, monochrome piano, rainy city, quiet interior. No text or buttons over covers, no 查看 buttons, no play overlays, no bordered card containers, no headings overlapping images. Fine clean alignment.

Bottom persistent player: small cover, 私生活 / 東京事変, sync dot and 3 人一起听, progress 1:28 / 3:49, heart, volume, lavender 下一首. No pause button. No upper right return button, mode switch, stacked tabs, redundant action rows, gradients, glow or heavy shadows. Small subtle corner label 设计稿 · 内容为示例.
